definitions.explanation: A photo album created to preserve memories of a special occasion such as a graduation, wedding, or school year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{記念|きねん}アルバム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記念|きねん}アルバム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a commemorative album of the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {記念|きねん}アルバム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: Every time I open the commemorative album, I remember my fun school days.

notes:
Combines ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧ (commemoration, memorial) with the loanword ⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧ (album). In Japan, ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{記念|きねん}アルバム (graduation albums) are a deeply rooted tradition. Most schools produce professional-quality albums at the end of the school year, and they are treasured keepsakes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{記念|きねん}アルバム: graduation commemorative album
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{記念|きねん}アルバム: wedding commemorative album
- {記念|きねん}アルバム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a commemorative album
- {記念|きねん}アルバム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}る→載る：27882_noru⟧: to appear in a commemorative album

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese school graduation albums (⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧) typically contain class photos, individual portraits, and candid shots from school events throughout the year. They are produced by professional photographers and are a standard part of the graduation experience at all school levels.
